spans.s:
अर्ण m. (-र्णः)
 1. The teak tree.
 2. A letter.

अर्णव m. (-वः) The ocean.
 E. अर्णस् water, व affix, and स is dropped: the
ण in this and similar words is optionally doubled, as अर्ण्णव, &c.

अर्णवज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Sea-born, marine.
 mn. (-जः-जं) Cuttlefish. E.
अर्णव, and ज born.

अर्णवमन्दिर m. (-रः) VARUṆA, regent of the water.
 E. अर्णव the ocean,
and मन्दिर a house; whose dwelling is the deep.

अर्णवपोत m. (-तः) A boat or ship.
 E. अर्णव, and पोत a boat.

अर्णवयान n. (-नं) A boat or ship.
 E. अर्णव, and यान vehicle.

अर्णस् n. (-र्णः) Water.
 E. ऋ to go, असुन् Unādi affix, and नट् inserted.

अर्णोद m. (-दः) A cloud.
 E. अणस्, and द what gives.

अर्णोभव m. (-वः) A shell.
 E. अर्णस्, and भव being.
